verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of plan-based daily task limits or concurrency limits for agent workflows, and no way to view or manage such limits. The closest item is Advanced Metrics on paid plans (usage, cost and productivity metrics). That is usage reporting, an adjacent feature, not plan limits or limit management.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can see and manage plan-based daily task and concurrency limits for agent workflows
